crop.pilot_relevance: Primary oilseed crop of Central Dry Zone (Zone IV) and historically dominant in Molakalmuru taluk
verified_sources: UAS Bangalore Package of Practices (Zone IV)

calendar.contingency_note: Dry sowing on shallow soils strictly warned against in erratic monsoon years (ICAR 2025 dryland advisory)

unfavorable_textures: Heavy black clay with poor drainage (causes pod rot and difficult digging)
soil_requirements.drainage: Well drained essential; sensitive to waterlogging

water_requirements.drought_hazard_note: Central Dry Zone has very-high drought hazard. Rainfed yields fluctuate widely between normal (1,474 kg/ha district avg) and drought years.

varieties.name: TMV-2
varieties.characteristics: Erect, medium bold pods, popular with rainfed farmers

varieties.name: GPBD-4
varieties.characteristics: Resistant to late leaf spot (tikka) and rust, high oil content

varieties.name: GKVK-5
varieties.characteristics: Bred specifically for Southern and Central Dry Zones of Karnataka

nutrient_evidence_conflict.description: Two authoritative sources provide different Recommended Doses of Fertilizers (RDF)

records.secondary_nutrients: 500 kg/ha gypsum (applied in 2 splits: basal and pegging)
records.condition: General Karnataka Zone IV irrigated or adequate moisture

records.source: ISSS NARP Central Dry Zone Table
records.secondary_nutrients: Gypsum depending on soil calcium status

nutrient_evidence_conflict.resolution_rule: DO NOT AVERAGE. If plot is strictly rainfed, report 25:50:25 as the dryland baseline with conflict noted. If farmer has soil test, compute STCR target dose instead.

major_pests_and_diseases.symptoms: Blistering on leaflets, webbed leaves, drying of foliage
major_pests_and_diseases.cultural_control: Intercropping with redgram or castor; light traps
major_pests_and_diseases.approved_chemical: Azadirachtin 0.03% EC or chlorantraniliprole 18.5 SC (Check CIB&RC)
major_pests_and_diseases.banned_warning: Older extension PDFs mention monocrotophos 36 SL. Monocrotophos is BANNED/RESTRICTED by CIB&RC. Hard safety gate blocks it.

major_pests_and_diseases.symptoms: Dark brown circular spots on leaf undersides, premature defoliation
major_pests_and_diseases.cultural_control: Crop rotation, use resistant varieties like GPBD-4
major_pests_and_diseases.approved_chemical: Mancozeb 75% WP or hexaconazole 5% SC as per CIB&RC Major Uses
